scope.reason: The sentence introducing the ruling (On those grounds, THE COURT hereby rules:) loses the holding role where the Court sets it on several lines: the General Court's unmarked opening row and the oldest layout's bare paragraphs. Derive the case number from every case-law CELEX document form by its court letter, so a Civil Service Tribunal order (62013FO0060) reads F-60/13 instead of the raw CELEX; the case number has no separate feature storage. A bare number after a dash in the keyword chain closes a range inside the keyword before it instead of standing as a keyword of its own; keywords have no separate feature storage.
